webdev.h1: Web Development Services for Fast, SEO-Ready Business Websites
webdev.lead: We design and develop high-performance websites and web apps focused on search visibility, conversion growth and stable Core Web Vitals.
webdev.intro2: We work with service companies, B2B teams and product startups that need predictable delivery, clear ownership and measurable business impact.
webdev.p1: Corporate websites with multilingual structure and technical SEO.
webdev.p2: High-converting landing pages for paid and organic traffic.
webdev.p3: Web apps and portals with clean architecture and scalable delivery.
webdev.result: Our process is aimed at ranking growth, lower acquisition cost and stronger lead quality by combining technical SEO, content structure and UX clarity.
webdev.result1: Discovery aligned with business goals and keyword intent clusters.
webdev.result2: Technical implementation optimized for crawlability and indexation.
webdev.result3: Content structure designed for conversion, not only traffic.

faq1.q: How long does a standard project take?
faq1.a: Most projects take 2-6 weeks depending on integrations, content readiness and approval cycles.

faq3.q: Can you improve an existing website instead of rebuilding it?
faq3.a: Yes, we run a technical audit first and then choose between targeted improvements or full rebuild based on ROI.

optimization.h1: SEO Optimization Services for Sustainable Organic Growth
optimization.lead: We improve rankings and lead quality through technical SEO, structured content architecture and measurable on-page optimization.
optimization.intro2: Our SEO work is execution-first: we prioritize fixes by impact, implement changes and validate the result in Search Console and analytics.
optimization.p1: Technical audits: indexability, canonicals, sitemap, robots and schema.
optimization.p2: On-page improvements: title, metadata, heading hierarchy and internal linking.
optimization.p3: Performance optimization for stronger Core Web Vitals.
optimization.analytics: We align Search Console, GA4 and conversion tracking to connect rankings with real pipeline impact.
optimization.r1: Index coverage monitoring and crawl issue resolution.
optimization.r2: Landing-page level KPI tracking for leads and conversions.
optimization.r3: Monthly roadmap with prioritized implementation backlog.

faq1.q: When should we expect first SEO results?
faq1.a: You can typically see early movement in 4-8 weeks, while stronger growth usually requires a 3-6 month execution window.

faq2.q: Do you only provide strategy or also implementation?
faq2.a: We do both: audit, prioritization, implementation and post-release validation.

faq3.q: Can SEO be done without changing design?
faq3.a: In many cases yes, especially for technical SEO, metadata and information architecture; UX changes are proposed only when needed.

head.description: Technical and on-page SEO services focused on indexability, Core Web Vitals, metadata quality and conversion-oriented organic traffic.

ecom.h1: E-commerce Development Services for Growth-Focused Stores
ecom.lead: We build ecommerce experiences on Shopify and custom stacks with high performance, SEO-ready category structure and conversion-driven UX.
ecom.intro2: Our focus is long-term store growth: better product discoverability, cleaner checkout flow and analytics you can trust for scaling decisions.
ecom.p1: Product and category SEO architecture with scalable URL strategy.
ecom.p2: Checkout, payments and analytics integrations for clean attribution.
ecom.p3: Performance-first storefronts with optimized media and low JS overhead.
ecom.value: A technically strong ecommerce stack improves crawlability, product discoverability and conversion consistency across paid and organic channels.
ecom.r1: SEO-first taxonomy for scalable category and filter pages.
ecom.r3: Tracking setup for revenue attribution and channel efficiency.

faq1.q: Do you work with Shopify only?
faq1.a: No, we work with Shopify and custom storefronts when business logic or integrations require more flexibility.

faq2.q: Can you migrate our current store?
faq2.a: Yes, we migrate catalog, content and key SEO signals while preserving URL logic and redirect integrity.

faq3.q: Do you optimize for SEO and ads together?
faq3.a: Yes, we align technical SEO with conversion tracking so paid and organic channels support each other.
